chapters.title: Nine Guesses at the Middle
chapters.blurb: A 256-message delta set peels seven AES rounds toward a four-round core, where nine guessed bytes fence in a meet-in-the-middle table.

chapters.title: The Byte That Cancels
chapters.blurb: The AES S-box turns one unknown key byte into a shared affine action; power-sum ratios and orbit canonicalization erase it from the match.

chapters.title: Making the Bridge Pay
chapters.blurb: Packed powers, a DDT-aware Gray walk, an XOR cache, canonicalization, and a layered verification program turn an algebraic saving into the paper's reported attack.
